issues: No integrity problems: the change only adds a cooling acceptance rule (temperature 0.003 down to 0.0002) to the search loop that removes a small circle and reinserts it elsewhere, and raises the random nudge to the centres from 0.003 to 0.005. There is no file or network access, no pasted coordinates, and no tampering with the result check.
No bugs found: best is still only replaced when strictly better, so the returned packing is the best one found; accepting worse results only changes where the search goes next.
The cooling schedule runs on the clock (time.time()), so results vary between runs even with a fixed seed. This is minor.
With one run per side the z value carries almost no information. The candidate (-2.636) equals the incumbent mean (-2.6360), so there is no improvement and rejecting is appropriate.
2.636 is consistent with the best known 2.635 after rounding, so it is not an implausible claim.
